org.name: Grace Community Church
org.tagline: A neighborhood church in North Boulder
org.mission: We gather on Sunday mornings to worship, share a meal on Wednesdays, and look after our neighbors the rest of the week. Grace has been on Broadway since 1978; most of the people who come are from the streets around it.
org.about:
Grace started in 1978 as a small group meeting in a living room on Alpine Avenue. The building on Broadway came in 1984 and has been patched, repainted and loved ever since.

Today about a hundred people call Grace home. Sunday services are simple: songs, a reading, a talk of about twenty minutes, and coffee afterwards that goes on longer than the service. Wednesday soup lunch is open to anyone in the neighborhood and is usually forty or fifty people.

The food pantry runs every second Saturday from the side door, in partnership with Community Food Share.

posts.title: Soup lunch is back to Wednesdays
posts.body:
After a summer of Thursdays we're back to Wednesdays from September 3rd. Doors open at 11:30 and we serve until the pot is empty, usually around 1pm.

If you'd like to help cook, come at 9am. No experience needed; there's always someone to show you the ropes.

posts.title: Garden beds ready for fall planting
posts.body: The raised beds on the south side are cleared and topped up. Garlic goes in the last weekend of October. Bring gloves if you have them; we have a few spare pairs.
